title: PROPERTY REFORM FAQ
why: Q2: states a live Freetown digital property database of 160,000+ properties using 11-character Plus Codes where street names or house numbers are unreliable, with deliveries and emergency access as uses (Freetown only).

title: DSTI Launches National High-Resolution Mapping Pilot
why: Q3: reports a four-month national high-resolution mapping pilot starting in Western Area Urban with wider rollout planned; pilot, not a nationwide address register.

title: Adrehs | Your location, in a code
why: Q2: live service to create and share location codes with district/chiefdom/section context; says it is not a postcode; government role not shown.

title: Adrehs for Developers | Location APIs for Sierra Leone
why: Q4: documents address-resolution APIs aimed at delivery, logistics and digital services; intended use, not shown adopted by public services.

title: Utilities & field services | Adrehs Use Cases
why: Q4: describes utility and field-service use cases for location codes; not independently verified.

title: City-Wide Property Geo-Mapping is Under Way
why: Q2: city-wide property geo-mapping after a three-ward pilot; Freetown only and older than three years, background for the property database.
